newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi plans to develop industrial zone in Asir.
newsitem.headline: Saudi plans to develop industrial zone in Asir.

text.p: Saudi Arabia plans to develop an industrial zone in the southwestern Asir farming region where 67 industrial projects will be implemented soon, the industry minister said.
Industry and Electricity Minister Hashem bin Abdullah bin Hashem Yamani was quoted in the daily Arab News as saying the new projects represented investment of 1.371 billion riyals ($366 million).
"This will help promote development in the Asir province," Yamani said.
He did not give a time for implementing the project or setting up the industrial zone.
The projects will bring to 120 the number of industrial concerns in the region, Yamani said.
About 1.1 million people live in the mountainous Asir region where agriculture is the main economic activity.
